text: S422 manually reviewed exact S417 Woven and S419 Polo Chromium crops and consolidated two concrete pending display decisions. Woven clipping removes 0.8426–0.8433 cm/side of the continuous source base seam; keeping it continuous preserves source fidelity and retains the 28-front hold. Polo H segmentation retains 60.139–72.361% as 2–3 clear arcs with zero sampled source-stroke contact over 17 options; approval would permit implementation/review only, not release.
